opensen.name: OpenSen
opensen.tagline: Learn English through chunking — memorize whole phrases, not words.
opensen.description: Open Sentence is a language learning ecosystem that helps learners memorize English through the chunking method: memorizing whole sentences and pre-assembled phrases so they retrieve language automatically rather than constructing it word-by-word.
features: Dialog Builder — Generate memorization-ready dialogs and speeches
Chunk Library — High-frequency native phrases with swap patterns
Situation Coverage — Real-world scenarios (small talk, ordering, travel, etc.)
Practice Plan — Spaced repetition based practice schedules
Anki export — Take your chunks anywhere

yt-hunter.name: YT Hunter
yt-hunter.tagline: Save YouTube URLs and auto-fetch transcripts instantly.
yt-hunter.description: A small open-source tool with a mobile app and browser extension. Paste a YouTube URL and YT Hunter automatically saves the video and fetches the transcript via TranscriptAPI — stored locally with the video reference.
features: Browser extension for Chrome & Firefox — one-click save
Mobile app (Flutter / React Native) for on-the-go capture
Local storage with IndexedDB — your data stays yours
Optional sync backend for multi-device access

open-farm.name: Open Farm Sui
open-farm.tagline: AI-powered agricultural trust platform on the Sui blockchain.
open-farm.description: Open Farm connects consumers directly with farmers through transparent crop stories, decentralized identity, and climate-aware farming intelligence. Scan a product QR code and instantly discover who grew your food, the harvest history, sustainability score, and AI-generated farming insights.
features: Farmer Passport — on-chain identity, trust score, sustainability badges
Harvest Story Timeline — crop journey from planting to delivery via Walrus storage
AI Farm Copilot — crop disease detection, weather predictions, irrigation suggestions
QR Crop Verification — consumers scan products to see full farm origin
Community Trust — reputation system connecting farmers and consumers directly
